Header.name: Dimitri Beubry–Niejinsky
Header.subtitle: Senior Full Stack Engineer — React, Node.js, Conversational AI

About.title: About
About.content: Senior full-stack engineer with 7 years of experience designing web applications and B2B products, with a strong focus on React, Node.js, and applied AI. I have designed and delivered rich interfaces, orchestration backends, and production AI workflows across document extraction, automation, and information retrieval use cases. I am now looking to contribute to AI-native products where user experience, backend architecture, and business value are designed together.

Highlights.title: Highlights
items: Design of AI products from scratch
React / Node.js on complex business applications
Backend orchestration, automation, and production rollout

items.title: 2023 – 2025 — CTO & Founder, LUPHY
items.summary: Founded and led an agency specializing in automation and applied AI product design to accelerate execution and business impact.
bullets: AI document platform for construction stakeholders on large-scale projects in an AMO / OPC context, enabling ingestion and structuring of heterogeneous corpora (meeting minutes, contractual documents, tracking sheets, technical documentation) and natural-language querying, with a sovereign architecture (Mistral AI, OVH), without sending full documents to the model, thanks to a chunk-based RAG pipeline and embeddings stored in pgvector.
Conversational assistant connected to the backend via MCP, enabling natural-language querying of a French holdings database and structured business results based on user criteria.

Monitoring and scoring tool across 400k companies, based on multi-source collection, public-data analysis, and LinkedIn enrichment, to connect companies, investors, sectors, and interest signals in an AI-assisted business research workflow.
Application for strategic information search and synthesis (founders, market, competitors), combining automated collection, context enrichment, and generation of an actionable investment memo.

AI assistant for travel reimbursement processing, with a React operator interface, data extraction from supporting documents, human takeover, and backend orchestration of business steps; processing capacity of 200+ files/day.
Email generation and orchestration engine for startup / investor roadshows, with AI-driven response classification and structured user follow-up.

items.title: 2021 – 2023 — Senior Full Stack, KSAAR SOLUTIONS
items.summary: Led key technical initiatives for a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform, with a central role in architecture, software quality, and product automation capabilities.
bullets: Developed a B2B SaaS platform adopted by 10k+ users.
Designed application and event-driven architecture to support product scalability.
Led monorepo / TypeScript migration to improve maintainability, technical consistency, and iteration speed.
Set up CI/CD, unit, integration, and load testing.
Built an automation platform and Stripe Connect / Yousign integrations.

items.title: 2019 – 2021 — Full Stack Developer, ENGIE-SOLUTIONS
items.summary: Developed B2B applications and real-time data streams in a demanding industrial environment.
bullets: SCRUM development of a B2B application.
Designed a real-time dashboard in Vue.js.
Asynchronous data-stream processing via Kafka to power real-time visualization without overloading the information system.

items.title: 2019 (9 months) — Junior Full Stack, EXCILYS
items.summary: First professional experience in an agile team on an internal web application.
bullets: Developed a web application for sharing and indexing skills.

items.title: 2017 – 2018 — Data Analyst, EIFER-EDF
items.summary: Analyzed monitoring data to improve operational performance on energy sites.
bullets: Analyzed five years of monitoring data.
Contributed to operational improvements on around ten micro-cogeneration units.
